spec: §8.4 + §13 + §14 (D14d) — D9-migration round-trip: provisional Layer-1 mnemonic -> L2 keyset -> quarantined legacy files
description: A realistic Layer-1 D9 identity dir (secret.hex + npub + mnemonic - Layer 1's own published NIP-06 test values) is migrated: the preserved mnemonic is re-read (section 8.4 hygiene), the L2 keyset derived (same words, NEW derivation - the NodeId changes once, pre-accepted D9/D13), the legacy dir renamed ASIDE WHOLE to '<dir>.quarantine-d9' (never deleted; secret.hex and npub ride along), and the new section 13 file set written atomically with a fresh announce counter of 0 (a NodeId no peer has seen - the floor+1024 rule does not apply). Detection is fail-closed: partial legacy, mixed legacy+new, an unmigratable dir and a bad-checksum mnemonic are refused (the bad-checksum case leaves the legacy dir untouched). The secp256k1 secret and npub are carried as opaque files - id111 has no secp256k1 machinery. Expect tokens: NotLegacyDir | CorruptLegacy | MixedState | Mnemonic.
provenance: Dir body from migrate.rs tests (Layer 1 NIP-06 values); new_node_id generated through migrate() for this freeze and independently re-derived by crosscheck.py.
